issuer: Alberta Transportation and Economic Corridors, through Alberta's registry agents
note: Alberta's Class 5 page (read 2026-10-30) says a full, non-GDL Class 5 licence needs the holder to be at least 18 and to have completed 24 months of probationary driving, so a full licence is kept from 18. Its fees are a registry agent's, up to the maxima in the Registry Agent Product Catalogue, which wasn't read today; the licence's fee and term are null, and the identification card isn't held (its page wasn't reached).

sources.title: Alberta, Class 5 driver's licence
sources.said: To get a full Class 5 (non-GDL) driver’s licence you must: be at least 18 years of age have completed the 24 months of probationary driving ... The maximum charges for the tests are outlined in the Registry Agent Product Catalogue
